key_phrases: Apple Intelligence marks the beginning of a new chapter
Services achieved an all-time revenue record
iPhone grew in every geographic segment
low- to mid-single digits year-over-year growth
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is highly positive, driven by record-breaking revenue in iPhone and Services, and the launch of Apple Intelligence. Management shows high confidence, particularly regarding the new AI era, though they remain cautious/evasive on specific China demand and tariff impacts. Quantitative specificity is very high with detailed segment revenues and margins provided. The forward guidance is slightly conservative (low-to-mid single digit growth), which analysts noted as a point of debate. Innovation momentum is the strongest driver due to the AI rollout.
